accepted_plan.role_plan: Orchestrator creates a dedicated child worktree and spawns a narrow-scope Workspace backend Coder. Reviewer will be spawned read-only after Coder reports implementation commit(s). After approval, Orchestrator integrates into `orchestration`, validates workspace-server/frontend/Nix as needed, records closure, and cleans only the child worktree/branch.
